request.spec: Return 'initials' as the upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot, e.g. 'J.S.'.
request.prompt:
Implement the following change to the application so that it fully satisfies
the specification and all existing and new tests pass. Run the test suite and
make it green before finishing.

Return 'initials' as the upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot, e.g. 'J.S.'.

code_review.final_verdict:
VERDICT: LGTM

The change follows the existing pattern in this file precisely. `getInitials()` sits directly beside `getDisplayName()`, which it mirrors in every structural respect: a `@Transient` derived getter on the `Owner` entity, same Javadoc shape ("Not persisted — derived from…"), and a single pure expression. Deriving the value on the entity is the right unit — no new class or service is warranted for a two-field computed string, and nothing is duplicated. The `openapi.yml` entry likewise mirrors the adjacent `displayName` schema (`readOnly: true`, title/description/example), so the contract stays consistent. A maintainer of this codebase would find both additions natural.

(Scope note per instructions: I did not assess correctness, e.g. behavior on empty/blank names.)
